info.name: Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFSC) REST API - Full Collection

request.description: The available capacity resource is used to view the actual available capacity. The available capacity is the total number of resource-hours dedicated to customer work for a particular day.

The booking resource is used to view the available booking options for an activity. Booking is a process of creating an appointment for customer work, finding time periods with enough quota and capacity, and helping booking managers find qualified resources for the work.

Displays a booking grid showing available time slots with capacity and quota information. This endpoint helps visualize booking availability across time periods and workzones, making it easier to find suitable appointment windows for scheduling activities.
The function provides a list of fields and properties required by showBookingGrid API function to determine parameters of activity that is going to be booked.

item.name: Create or update booking closing schedules

request.description: The booking closing schedule resource is used to view and update the closing schedules and statuses of bookings. The booking statuses allow you to open, close, or update bookings for capacity areas, workzones, and timeslots/time intervals.
Retrieves the current booking closing schedules for capacity areas. This allows you to view which time periods are open or closed for booking in specific areas and workzones.
Retrieves the current booking statuses (open/closed) for specific time intervals, workzones, and capacity areas. This helps determine which time slots are available for customer bookings.

Opens or closes specific booking time slots for capacity areas and workzones. Use this to control customer booking availability by making time periods bookable or non-bookable based on business needs.
The quota resource is used to view and update quota for capacity areas. Updating quota lets you allocate time values to the different types of work that is performed in your organization.
Retrieves quota allocation for capacity areas. Quota defines the amount of time dedicated to different work types in specific areas, helping balance workload distribution.
The quota resource is used to view and update quota for capacity areas. Updating quota lets you allocate time values to the different types of work that is performed in your organization.
Retrieves quota allocation using the v2 API with enhanced features and additional filtering options. Provides more granular control over quota queries compared to v1.
The address book resource is used to fetch the address book details
The chats resource is used to start or leave a chat, invite or view chat participants, or send a message on an existing chat. Real-time messages can be sent and received using chats.
Sends a new message to a chat conversation. All participants in the chat will receive the message, enabling real-time team communication.
Creates a new chat conversation with specified participants. Use this to initiate discussions about activities, coordinate work, or communicate with team members.
The activity actions resource is used to perform various actions on activities such as start activity, delay activity, move activity, complete activity, and so on.

item.name: Change activity status from enroute to pending

request.description: Stops travel for an activity and changes its status from enroute back to pending. Use this when a technician needs to stop traveling to an activity location, perhaps due to an emergency or schedule change.
Marks an activity as started, indicating that the technician has begun working on the job. This action typically records the start time and changes the activity status to 'started'.
Initiates the prework phase of an activity. Prework allows technicians to begin preparation tasks before arriving at the customer location, such as reviewing documentation or gathering parts.
Temporarily suspends an activity, pausing the work without completing it. Use this when work must be interrupted due to missing parts, awaiting customer response, or other blocking issues.

item.name: Update the activity status to enroute

request.description: Changes the activity status to enroute, indicating that the technician is traveling to the activity location. This helps track technician location and provides customers with accurate arrival estimates.

item.name: Update the activity status to notdone

request.description: Marks an activity as not done, indicating that the work could not be completed. Use this when the activity cannot be finished due to customer unavailability, access issues, or other obstacles requiring rescheduling.

The activity file properties resource is used to view, create, or delete a file property for a specific activity. The file property may be used to transfer files such as documents, photos, signatures, and so on.
Retrieves a file property (such as photos, documents, or signatures) attached to an activity. Use this to download files that technicians have uploaded during service delivery.
Uploads or updates a file property for an activity. Use this to attach documents, photos, customer signatures, or other files to service activities for documentation and compliance purposes.
This operation returns information about external files from the specified activity property. The property should have the type 'Attachments' configured with the 'OCI Object Storage' storage type.
This operation uploads information about external links to file attachments to the specified activity property.

The activity inventories resource is used to view or create customer inventories for a specific activity and view installed and deinstalled inventories for a specific activity. Activity inventories are the inventories assigned to perform an activity.

The activity links resource is used to view, create, update, or delete links associated with the specific activity. Links are used to identify dependencies between activities. For example, Activity A must be complete before Activity B can start.

item.name: Delete required inventories of an activity

request.description: The activity required inventories resource is used to view, create, update, or delete required inventories for a specific activity. Activity inventories are the inventories required to perform an activity.

item.name: Get required inventories of an activity
Set required inventories for an activity
Delete resource preferences of an activity

request.description: The activity resource preferences resource is used to view, create, update, or delete resource preferences for a specific activity. Resource preferences identify whether certain resources are preferred, required, or forbidden from being assigned to the activity.

item.name: Get resource preferences of an activity
Set resource preferences of an activity

request.description: The list of submitted forms associated with the activity.

The activities resource is used to view, create, or update activities. It is also used to search for activities based on a specified criteria, view individual segments of segmentable activities, and retrieve activity status and technician information. An activity is any time-consuming task done by a resource. For example, installation, trouble call, lunch, team meeting, and so on.

request.description: The activity duration resource is used to view and modify the activity durations in Oracle Field Service. There might be scenarios where the customer has a specific activity duration they want to use to achieve some business objective. In such cases, they can use this operation to view and override the system estimated durations.

The activity travel resource is used to obtain and modify the travel durations in Oracle Field Service. There might be scenarios where the customer has a specific travel duration they want to use to achieve some business objective. In such cases, they can use this operation to view and override the system estimated durations.

The Airline Distance Based Travel resource is used to view and modify the travel time at the travel key level in Oracle Field Service. There might be scenarios where the customer has a specific travel time for specific distance they want to use to achieve some business objective. In such cases, they can use this operation to view and override the system estimated travel time duration at the travel key level.
